definition.purpose: Focused optimizer-only BCAP comparison: exactly 41 complete global recipes, fixed protocol seed 0, six required Tier 1 tasks plus the existing clock audit diagnostic, and no higher tiers. Complete independent current-tier jobs despite another peer failing. One worker per GPU, at most two GPU workers plus the existing automatic CPU worker; wall time is cost evidence only. Existing task data, architectures, initialization, priors, sampling, objectives, schedules, update budgets and evaluators remain fixed. Initial stage is a finite coarse rate screen, not the full requested Cartesian grid. No seed repetitions, gate repairs, default adoption, R1/R2/native/scale-transfer runs or automatic continuation. An edge optimum is reported as unresolved and may motivate a separately registered finite follow-up only for a supported-task improvement over the matched Adam control.

diagnostics: RNG-free actual-step observers enabled for scalar/ring/joint-word hosts; excluded from grading. Frozen input-gradient probes excluded due to phase-label routing; update/weight/spectral traces retained.

predictions.P1: unscored: original native benchmarks and five-seed equivalence absent
predictions.P2: screening evidence only; no five-seed falsification
predictions.P5: screening evidence only; native five-seed equivalence deferred

scope: optimizer-only BCAP, protocol seed 0, complete current Tier 1; no task repairs or later tiers
